rules.claim: source register is complete and honest about how much was read
product-intent records keep confirmation and observation apart, and never fill a blank with an inference
link register states exactly what was followed, including the absence of a tag
every cross-reference resolves: flags, sources, products, clusters, events
recorded tallies match the data they describe
docs/ was generated from the current data/ and content/
every page: head furniture, disclosure above the fold and in the footer, tagged and marked outbound links, registered citations, no banned voice, no broken links
structured data parses and never claims more than the site can support
sitemap, feed and robots are consistent with the files on disk
measurement state in the markup agrees with config; opt-out is honoured
the campaign ledger has its schema and no unprovenanced numbers
no conversion score or revenue forecast appears anywhere
